objective: Resolve repository validation failure caused by governance hash mismatches and stale database snapshot index.
why_it_exists: Unregistered changes to governance documents break automated validation, preventing any promotional or execution actions.

execution_steps.description: Initialize the governance integrity hash registry to capture current states of AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md.
Snapshot the database registry registries to restore freshness alignment.
Rerun scripts/global_validate.py to verify clean passing state.

success_definition: Governance integrity is aligned with the active commit, database snapshot is fresh, and repository-wide validation passes without errors.
failure_conditions: global_validate.py continues to exit with a non-zero code.
Hash registry update does not cover all modified assets.
